name: Stashly - Vault tool
tagline: Stashly – A simple, secure way to manage your personal files and notes.
blurb: Stashly is a simple Android app to save, organize, and secure your links, notes, and files in one place.
description:
Stashly is a simple Android app to save, organize, and secure your links, notes, and files in one place.

Features

- Save and manage links, notes, and files

- Secure Vault for sensitive data (offline access)

- Import and export essentials with ease

- Material You theming and beautiful dark mode

- Lightweight, fast, and privacy-friendly (no ads, no trackers)
